---
title: "A script to forge T2T-CHM13 NCBI GCF Assembly using BSGenomeForge"
author: "Stefanus Bernard"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

# 2nd method try to forge our own BSGenome package from T2T-CHM13 NCBI GCF assembly

```{r}

BiocManager::install("BSgenomeForge", force = TRUE)
library(BSgenomeForge)

# Anchor all output to the script's directory, not the R session's getwd()
script_dir <- dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)

# Increase timeout to 2 hours — the T2T-CHM13 genome is ~3 GB
options(timeout = 7200)

forgeBSgenomeDataPkgFromNCBI(
  assembly_accession = "GCF_009914755.1",
  organism = "Homo sapiens",
  pkg_maintainer = "Stefanus Bernard <s.bernard5@universityofgalway.ie>",
  circ_seqs = character(0),  # The NCBI RefSeq assembly differs from the submitted assembly in the following ways: Removed chromosome MT
  destdir = script_dir
)

install.packages(
  file.path(script_dir, "BSgenome.Hsapiens.NCBI.T2TCHM13v2.0"),
  repos = NULL, type = "source"
)

library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.NCBI.T2TCHM13v2.0)

```
